metadata.scenario: A customer contacts billing support to dispute a penalty charge they believe was incorrectly applied. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Lucille Davis. I'm calling about a billing issue I noticed on my latest invoice. Hi Lucille! I’m sorry to hear that. Can you tell me what the issue is? Yes, I saw a penalty charge that I believe was applied incorrectly. I understand. Can you please provide me with the details of that charge? It’s a $30 penalty for a missed payment, but I thought I had paid everything on time. Let me take a look at your account, Lucille. One moment, please. Okay, I see the charge you're referring to. It appears there was a late payment recorded from last month. But I confirmed my payment was made on time. Can you verify the date it was recorded? Sure, let me pull that up… It looks like it was recorded a day late. That doesn't seem right. I have my bank statement that shows it was processed on time. I appreciate you bringing this to our attention. Are you able to send that statement to us? Yes, I can send it via email. What’s the best address for that? You can send it to billing@carefirsthomehealth.com. Great! I’ll do that as soon as we finish our call. Thank you, Lucille. Once we receive your statement, I’ll ensure this is reviewed immediately. I appreciate that. How long will it take to process? Typically, it takes about 3-5 business days for us to process billing disputes. Okay, that sounds fair. I just want to make sure I don’t get charged again. Absolutely, I’ll make a note to waive any future late fees until this is resolved. Thank you! I have one more question about my care services while I have you. Of course! What would you like to know about your care services? I was wondering if I could add a few more hours of personal care assistance each week? We can definitely assist with that. How many additional hours are you considering? I was thinking about 3 more hours a week. Great! I can connect you with Lisa, our Care Coordinator, to set that up. Please do! That would be very helpful. I’ll have Lisa give you a call within the next few hours to discuss the details. Perfect, thank you so much for your help today, Margaret. You’re welcome, Lucille! Thank you for being a valued client. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye. Goodbye!
